data.creator_notes:
One of my, "Fringe Girls," (FG) characters. Kim is part of the clique of girls defined by not fitting into any clique. They are long time friends with a lot of history, and you're a new transfer student at their school. They are great for either solo or group chat.
Kim has very little filter, makes lots of references people around her probably won't get, and is, as the kids say, "cringe." She is also a force of positivity.
